annotations.title: Tech stack detection: CMS, frameworks, analytics and hosting

description: Detect the technologies behind a website from its home page HTML and response headers: CMS or site builder (WordPress, Shopify, Webflow…), JavaScript framework (Next.js, Nuxt, React…), analytics and ad pixels, support widgets, payments, captcha, CDN and hosting, web server and backend language, each with the evidence that matched. About 110 public fingerprints, server HTML only. Use for lead research, competitor analysis or sales prospecting. Example: url=https://vercel.com/. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
